title: My Help Comes from the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite pilgrim walks along a rugged road through the hills toward Jerusalem. He pauses on a rise and looks toward the mountains ahead, wondering where his help will come from. A trusted older companion gestures toward the path and continues walking beside him, encouraging him that the Maker of heaven and earth watches over their journey. The landscape includes stony slopes, olive trees, small valleys, and a narrow road winding between hills. In the foreground, the pilgrim steps carefully over uneven ground, while the sun moves across the sky, casting natural shadows that suggest the passage of time. A small shade tree offers brief rest from the heat, visually echoing the psalm's assurance that the LORD is a keeper and shade at the right hand. The travelers continue toward the city without signs of panic. The scene should communicate protection on the journey, from departure to return, without depicting an invisible divine shield as a literal object. Historically plausible garments, staffs, sandals, and natural light. No modern roads, equipment, or fantasy effects.

title: I Was Glad When They Said, Let Us Go to the House of the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a joyful group of Israelite pilgrims approaches the gates of ancient Jerusalem along a stone road. Families walk together carrying small bundles, water jars, and modest offerings. The travelers' faces show relief and gladness as they see the city walls and sanctuary rising above the surrounding hills. A child points excitedly toward the gates, while an elder explains the importance of the city and its place in the life of the people. Inside the gates, the streets are active with residents, visiting worshippers, and elders gathering near a place of judgment. The city should appear compact and historically plausible, with limestone walls, timber doors, flat-roofed houses, and narrow streets. The scene conveys unity, shared worship, and the joy of arriving in the house of the LORD after a long journey. Avoid resembling a modern pilgrimage or inserting later temple architecture without regard to chronology. No modern objects, printed signs, or fantasy effects.

title: Pray for the Peace of Jerusalem
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an elder and several pilgrims stand on a raised terrace inside ancient Jerusalem, looking over the rooftops, walls, and sanctuary. They pray earnestly for the city's peace and for the well-being of those who love it. Nearby, merchants open their stalls, children carry water, and neighbors greet one another at the doorway of a stone house, reflecting that peace is lived out through ordinary relationships as well as through secure walls. At the city gate, guards remain watchful but calm, and elders listen to a local dispute with fairness. The pilgrims' expressions are hopeful rather than triumphant. The composition should communicate the desire for peace within Jerusalem's walls, prosperity within its palaces, and good for the sake of family and fellow worshippers. Historically plausible ancient garments, city architecture, woven awnings, and warm natural light. No modern flags, vehicles, signs, or fantasy effects.

title: Our Eyes Look to the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of humble Israelite worshippers gathers in a quiet courtyard, their faces lifted toward the sky in prayer. An older man stands beside a stone doorway, raising his eyes with patience and dependence, while a woman and a younger traveler wait quietly beside him. The image should draw a visual parallel between servants watching the hand of their master and worshippers looking to God for mercy, without portraying the LORD as a literal household master in the scene. In the background, several prosperous people pass through the street and speak dismissively, symbolizing the contempt and scorn endured by those who are vulnerable. The worshippers remain dignified, asking for mercy rather than seeking retaliation. Simple woven garments, clay lamps, limestone walls, and natural midday light create a grounded ancient setting. The atmosphere is restrained, conveying patient expectation amid mockery and pride. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: If the LORD Had Not Been on Our Side
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a community of Israelites stands on a rocky rise above a valley after narrowly escaping a serious threat. Behind them, a narrow path descends toward a turbulent stream, while the far side of the valley contains distant hostile figures whose presence suggests overwhelming opposition. The Israelites look back with relief and humility, aware that they could not have survived the danger by their own strength alone. Several people support an exhausted elder and guide children toward a safe road, showing that the community has been preserved together. The water below is powerful but does not sweep away the people, and no injuries are shown. The composition should visualize the psalm's images of being swallowed alive, overwhelmed by waters, and nearly engulfed by a torrent as poetic descriptions of danger, without depicting a literal disaster. Ancient Israelite clothing, rugged terrain, realistic water, and natural light. No modern objects, graphic violence, or fantasy effects.

title: Our Help Is in the Name of the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a freed Israelite traveler stands beside a simple snare laid on the ground near a rocky path. The trap lies broken and empty, symbolizing the psalm's image of a bird escaping from a snare. The traveler looks toward the sky in thanksgiving while several companions gather around him, relieved that they have escaped a danger they could not overcome alone. Behind them, a secure road leads toward a fortified settlement visible in the distance. The travelers' clothing is dusty and worn, but their expressions convey gratitude and renewed confidence. The broken snare should be a small and realistic object, not an exaggerated mechanical device. The scene expresses the psalm's closing confession that help comes from the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth. Historically plausible ancient garments, rope and wood construction, rocky terrain, and clear natural light. No modern traps, equipment, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: Those Who Trust in the LORD Are Like Mount Zion
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a panoramic view of ancient Jerusalem on Mount Zion, surrounded by the hills of the Judean landscape. The city walls and sanctuary are visible above modest stone houses, while surrounding mountains form a natural ring around the settlement. On a nearby ridge, Israelite families stand together looking toward the city, their expressions peaceful and confident. The surrounding hills should appear strong and enduring, reflecting the psalm's image of those who trust in the LORD being unshaken and the LORD surrounding His people. The scene should also retain the moral seriousness of the psalm's warning that the upright should not be led toward wrongdoing. Use historically plausible ancient architecture, realistic terrain, olive trees, and bright natural light. No modern skyline, paved roads, flags, or fantasy effects.

title: When the LORD Turned Again the Captivity of Zion
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of Israelite families returns to a settlement near Jerusalem after a long period away. They walk along an ancient road carrying bundles and small household possessions, accompanied by children and elders. Their expressions shift from disbelief to joy as they see familiar walls and rooftops ahead. Several residents who remained in the area hurry out to welcome them, embracing relatives and laughing with relief. A musician lifts a lyre, and children clap their hands as the gathered community remembers the LORD's great work on their behalf. The scene should convey restoration, laughter, and renewed joy without assigning a specific historical exile or return unless a context explicitly establishes it. Use authentic ancient clothing, realistic expressions, natural light, and detailed architecture. No modern luggage, signage, or fantasy effects.

title: Those Who Sow in Tears Shall Reap in Joy
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a farmer in ancient Israel walks across a field at the start of the planting season. He carries a woven bag of seed and scatters grains carefully over the soil. His expression is thoughtful and tired, as though the planting follows a difficult season when the household has known sorrow and uncertainty. His family works alongside him, preparing the ground and repairing a small irrigation channel. In the background, another part of the field shows young green shoots beginning to emerge, suggesting the future harvest without making it instantaneous. At the edge of the field, an older farmer looks toward the sky and offers a quiet prayer for rain and renewed life. The image should communicate the psalm's movement from tears to joy through patient labor and hope in God, rather than asserting that every sorrow leads to immediate material success. Historically plausible farming tools, seed baskets, ancient garments, and natural sunlight. No modern tractors, machinery, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Unless the LORD Builds the House
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite family and a group of builders work on a modest stone house. One worker carefully places stones while another prepares timber beams, and the household head watches the progress with a thoughtful expression. Nearby, a night watchman sits at the city gate, alert but exhausted, symbolizing the limits of human effort when trust in God is absent. A family member brings food to the workers, and an elder reminds the household that labor and vigilance matter, yet they cannot replace dependence on the LORD. The house is under construction but remains realistic in scale and design, with limestone blocks, wooden supports, and a flat roof. A calm evening sky contrasts with the hurried gestures of one anxious worker who continues late into the night. The scene should express the psalm's warning against anxious toil without presenting work itself as wrong. Authentic ancient tools, garments, architecture, and natural light. No modern machinery, steel construction, or fantasy effects.

title: Children Are a Heritage from the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite household gathers in an outdoor courtyard beneath a shade tree. Parents sit with several children of different ages, listening as an elder offers wisdom about family responsibility and the value of the next generation. One parent gently teaches a child how to carry a small basket, while another helps a younger child with a simple task. In the background, an adult prepares supplies for the city gate, evoking the psalm's comparison of children to arrows in the hand of a warrior and the image of a household strengthened by its family. Historically plausible ancient clothing, stone houses, woven baskets, and natural daylight. No modern toys, school equipment, or fantasy effects.

title: Blessed Is Everyone Who Fears the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a hardworking Israelite father returns to his home at the end of the day. His clothing shows dust from the field, and he carries a simple farming tool. His family welcomes him into a modest stone courtyard where a meal is being prepared. His wife sits beside a healthy grapevine that climbs along a wooden support, and their children gather near an olive tree, representing the psalm's imagery of a fruitful household and children like olive shoots around the table. The scene should convey blessing through reverence for God, honest labor, family affection, and an ordered home, not through extravagant wealth or an unrealistic ideal of family life. Use authentic ancient Israelite garments, local plants, simple furniture, pottery, and warm evening light. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: May You See the Good of Jerusalem
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an older Israelite man stands on a terrace overlooking Jerusalem, accompanied by his spouse, adult children, and grandchildren. title: Many a Time Have They Afflicted Me from My Youth
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of Israelites stands on a rocky hillside overlooking an ancient settlement. One elder wears a simple cloak with signs of age and hardship, but his posture is upright. title: Let Those Who Hate Zion Be Ashamed
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, ancient Jerusalem rises above the surrounding hills as a small group of pilgrims approaches along a dusty road. On a distant slope, hostile men who have spoken against Zion stand apart from the peaceful travelers, their expressions frustrated as their plans have not succeeded. The pilgrims continue toward the city, looking ahead with quiet confidence. title: Out of the Depths I Cry to You
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite worshipper kneels beside a deep stone-lined well in a quiet courtyard at dawn. In the background, an elder and another worshipper wait near the sanctuary entrance, emphasizing the seriousness of seeking forgiveness and the hope that God is merciful. title: My Soul Waits for the LORD More Than Watchmen for the Morning
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a night watchman stands on the wall of ancient Jerusalem, looking outward across the dark hills while waiting for dawn. As the sky begins to lighten, the watchman relaxes his posture and the worshipper raises his head with hope. The scene should express patient expectation, redemption, and confidence in the abundance of God's mercy, not imply that the answer to every prayer is immediate. Use realistic ancient walls, garments, oil lamps, and natural transition from night to dawn. No modern clocks, surveillance equipment, visible text, or fantasy effects.

title: My Soul Is Like a Weaned Child with Its Mother
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite mother sits in a shaded courtyard with a calm young child resting securely beside her. The child leans gently against her, peaceful and content, while the mother looks outward with a quiet, thoughtful expression. Nearby, an older man sits on a stone bench in prayer, showing that the psalm's image of quiet trust can characterize an adult worshipper who has put away pride and stopped pursuing matters beyond his understanding. The setting is simple and intimate, with a woven mat, clay water vessel, olive tree, and a modest stone doorway. The child is old enough to appear settled and reassured, not depicted in distress. The composition should communicate humility, inner stillness, freedom from arrogance, and hope in the LORD from this time forward. Historically plausible ancient Israelite clothing and household details, soft daylight, realistic expressions. No modern furniture, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Remember David and His Desire to Build a Dwelling for God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, King David walks through ancient Jerusalem accompanied by a small group of advisers. title: Let Us Go into His Dwelling Place
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite procession approaches the sanctuary carrying a sacred chest under carefully arranged coverings, with priests and attendants guiding the movement. title: The LORD Swore to David a Sure Covenant
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a solemn royal scene in ancient Jerusalem showing a king seated before trusted elders and family members. The king's posture is dignified but humble, and the room is furnished with simple wooden seats, woven curtains, and oil lamps. The image should express divine covenant, the hope of an enduring royal line, and the blessing of Zion. Historically plausible Israelite garments and architecture, parchment, and warm lamplight. No medieval royal symbols, modern objects, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: Behold, How Good It Is for Brothers to Dwell Together in Unity
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a gathering of Israelite families, elders, and travelers share a peaceful meal in an open courtyard. Avoid turning the oil ritual into a later church practice or depicting it as magical. Historically plausible Israelite garments, clay vessels, woven mats, natural plants, and soft daylight. No modern tableware, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Bless the LORD, All You Servants of the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite sanctuary courtyard at night. title: Praise the LORD Who Chose Israel

Avoid depicting several historical episodes as one literal event. Use realistic ancient Near Eastern terrain, historically plausible Egyptian and Israelite clothing, stone architecture, and natural light. No modern maps, flags, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: The LORD's Name Endures Forever
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of Israelites gathers near the sanctuary as an elder explains the contrast between the living God and idols fashioned by human hands. title: His Mercy Endures Forever: The Creator of Heaven and Earth
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of Israelite worshippers stands in an open courtyard at sunrise, responding in praise as an elder recounts the works of creation. title: His Mercy Endures Forever: Deliverance from Egypt

title: His Mercy Endures Forever: Kings Overthrown and Land Given

title: His Mercy Endures Forever: He Remembers Us
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite family gathers around a simple table in a modest stone home after a period of hardship. title: By the Rivers of Babylon, We Sat and Wept

title: If I Forget You, O Jerusalem

title: I Will Praise You with My Whole Heart

title: Though the LORD Is High, He Regards the Lowly

title: O LORD, You Have Searched Me and Known Me

title: Where Can I Go from Your Spirit?

title: You Formed My Inward Parts

title: Search Me, O God, and Know My Heart

title: Deliver Me from Violent Men
